oneLine.description: What the phone shows, under 110 characters.

why.description: One line: why this is urgent, or why it's sent now.

followed.description: Optional: indexes (from 0) into feedback of the lines that changed this send. The board quotes them to the user.

nextWakeIn.description: Minutes until you want to look again (1 to 1440).

notes.description: Notes for your next run (what you held and why, what to watch).

log.description: One line for the user's log: what you did and why.
